title: 第15章 燎原百击VS千雷破第16章 登顶第一
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 王冲飞掠而来，立于高空，长发舞动，一袭白衣迎风猎猎，他双眸似有精芒吞吐，手中那一杆银色长枪闪烁着炽盛的光亮。
秦逸站在山巅，一袭黑衫，身形笔挺，身上透着一股霸道气概，极品灵剑在他手中，发出铿锵之声，身边似有无数的无形剑气在呼啸。
两人的目光对视，顿时，天地之间，似有枪剑碰撞，发出清脆的金属交击声，力量轰鸣。
周围，所有人都睁大了眼睛，满脸期待之色。
“秦逸身上的气息，不似之前那般强大了，看来，那女子对他的辅助之效已经过去。”
“如果秦逸还是刚才那种状态，或许能勉强有一战之力，但现在……他不可能是王冲的对手。”
“王冲虽跟李云霄一样，都是结丹境一重修为，但王冲凝结的乃是上品银丹，他的力量，比李云霄强很多。”
“而且，王冲拥有极品火灵体，枪法非常厉害，他将一门地阶下品的燎原枪法，都修炼到了圆满之境，并且领悟了烈火枪意！”
刚在秦逸剑锋下，吃了大亏的李云霄，其本身也是一个极为骄傲的人，但此时此刻，也发自内心的说道：“我远不如王兄。”
“一个月前，我曾与王兄私下里切磋过，我在王兄手中，没有撑过十招。”
“而且，我能感觉得出来，当时的王兄，未尽全力！”
李云霄的这番话，让人更清晰地意识到王冲的强大之处。
空中，王冲看着秦逸，淡淡道：“我参加天星武院的考核，我现在所拥有的星辰点，都是我独自一人获得，没有找任何人帮忙。”
秦逸道：“你想表达什么？”
王冲道：“这个第一，非我莫属！”
语气加重了一些，脸上浮现无比自信的神色，仿佛第一名是他的，理所当然。
秦逸嘴角上扬，道：“如果我没来，第一的确是你的，但你运气不太好，所以，就只能委屈你，当个第二了。”
王冲的眼睛微微眯起：“你很自信，但在我的面前，你的自信便显得有些不太合适。”
秦逸提在手中的剑，直接举起，剑尖对着王冲：“合适不合适，我的剑说了算。”
王冲眸光一闪。
“吃我一枪！”
刹那间。
他手臂一甩，银色长枪，直接脱手朝着秦逸爆射。
长枪破空，速度惊人，掀起恐怖的音啸，长枪表面，竟浮现一条蛟龙虚影。
他的长枪，也是极品灵器，就叫蛟龙枪，以蛟龙鳞骨为材料，用蛟龙精血淬炼而成，威势强大。
眨眼之间，王冲的蛟龙枪，便已射杀至秦逸面前。
秦逸的剑锋轻轻一颤，便有十层剑光席卷而出。
叠浪剑法！
王冲的蛟龙枪，以摧枯拉朽之势，洞穿了一层又一层剑光，当洞穿九层剑光后，蛟龙枪中的力量明显减弱了许多，被第十层剑光挡下。
“那你也受我一剑！”
秦逸大喝，第十层剑光猛然扩散，将王冲的蛟龙枪掀飞，紧接着，一剑朝着王冲掠去。
刹那间，天地一声惊雷炸响。
惊雷剑法，平地起惊雷！
缭绕着雷霆的剑气，迅疾无匹，朝着王冲斩去。
王冲眼中的精芒，瞬间暴涨，轰的一声，他的身上爆发出了恐怖的火光。
content_en:
Wang Chong flew over, standing high in the sky, his long hair dancing, and he was dressed in white and hunting in the wind. His eyes seemed to be shining brightly, and the silver spear in his hand was shining with blazing light.
Qin Yi stood on the top of the mountain, dressed in black, upright and exuding a domineering aura. The top-quality spiritual sword in his hand made a clanging sound, and there seemed to be countless invisible sword energy whistling around him.
The two people looked at each other, and suddenly, there seemed to be a collision of guns and swords between heaven and earth, making a crisp sound of metal clashing, and a roar of power.
Everyone around them opened their eyes wide with anticipation.
"The aura on Qin Yi's body is not as strong as before. It seems that the woman's assisting effect on him has passed."
"If Qin Yi is still in the same state just now, he might be able to fight, but now...he cannot be Wang Chong's opponent."
"Although Wang Chong, like Li Yunxiao, is at the first level of the Dan Formation Realm, Wang Chong condenses high-grade silver elixirs. His power is much stronger than Li Yunxiao."
"Furthermore, Wang Chong possesses a top-grade fire spirit body, and his marksmanship is very powerful. He has perfected the low-level prairie fire spear technique, which is a low-grade earth-level weapon, and has understood the meaning of the fierce fire spear!"
Li Yunxiao, who had just suffered a big loss under Qin Yi's sword, was also an extremely proud person, but at this moment, he also said from the bottom of his heart: "I am far inferior to Brother Wang."
"A month ago, I had a private discussion with Brother Wang. I couldn't survive ten moves in Brother Wang's hands."
"Besides, I can feel that Brother Wang at that time did not try his best!"
Li Yunxiao's words made people more clearly aware of Wang Chong's power.
In the air, Wang Chong looked at Qin Yi and said calmly: "I participated in the assessment of Tianxing Martial Arts Academy. The star points I have now were obtained by myself without asking anyone for help."
Qin Yidao: "What do you want to express?"
Wang Chong said: "This number one belongs to me!"
His tone became a little more serious, and there was an extremely confident look on his face, as if the first place was his and it was natural.
The corner of Qin Yi's mouth raised and he said: "If I hadn't come, the first place would indeed be yours, but you are not very lucky, so I can only wrong you and be the second place."
Wang Chong's eyes narrowed slightly: "You are very confident, but in front of me, your confidence seems a bit inappropriate."
"Buzz!"
Qin Yiti raised the sword in his hand and pointed the tip towards Wang Chong: "My sword has the final say whether it's suitable or not."
Wang Chong's eyes flashed.
"Take my shot!"
In an instant.
He flicked his arm and fired the silver spear directly at Qin Yi.
The spear broke through the air at an astonishing speed, setting off a terrifying howl, and a phantom of a dragon appeared on the surface of the spear.
His spear is also a top-grade spiritual weapon. It is called the Dragon Spear. It is made of dragon scale bones and tempered with dragon essence and blood. It is very powerful.
In the blink of an eye, Wang Chong's dragon spear shot in front of Qin Yi.
Qin Yi's sword edge trembled slightly, and ten layers of sword light swept out.
Dielang Sword Technique!
Wang Chong's dragon spear penetrated layer after layer of sword light with devastating force. After penetrating through the nine layers of sword light, the power in the dragon spear was significantly weakened and was blocked by the tenth layer of sword light.
"Then you will take my sword too!"
Qin Yi shouted, and the tenth level of sword light suddenly spread, knocking Wang Chong's dragon spear away, and then, a sword flew towards Wang Chong.
In an instant, there was a thunderous explosion in the sky and the earth.
Thunder Sword Technique, thunder from flat ground!
The sword energy swirling with thunder struck towards Wang Chong with unparalleled speed.
The sparkle in Wang Chong's eyes suddenly surged, and with a bang, terrifying fire erupted from his body.
